kind: changed-case diagnostic; development evidence, not a registered confirmation and not an unconditional gain
question: Where the win-rate table would take an artifact none of the five known creatures can use, is the best usable artifact on the same offer better?
design: Every distinct roster of three lifecycle banks (726). For a roster with such an artifact in the live pool, one three-artifact offer on which the two rules disagree was sampled by hash. The pair of games differs only in that seat's Tier-2 artifact; both seats are the A19 profile v14 default, full production lifecycle.

reading.giantsMaul: Judge it on the five known creatures. The replacement did no worse when a level-4 area attacker arrived and much better when none did.
reading.farsightQuiver: A level-4 shooter makes it strong (8 pairs, all in favour of keeping it), so the rule applies only to a seat that will not add a shooter, or to advice about the army as it stands.
